Interface IBindingInstanceModel

All Superinterfaces:
IBindingInstance, IBindingModelElement, dev.metaschema.core.model.IDefaultable, dev.metaschema.core.model.IGroupable, dev.metaschema.core.model.IInstance, dev.metaschema.core.model.IModelElement, dev.metaschema.core.model.IModelElementVisitable, dev.metaschema.core.model.IModelInstance
public interface IBindingInstanceModel extends IBindingInstance, dev.metaschema.core.model.IModelInstance
Represents a Metaschema model instance loaded via data binding.

This interface provides access to binding-specific metadata for field and assembly instances.
